(I)--originator of the यादव race; the eldest son of ययाति and देवयानी. Father of Sahasrajit and other sons.
1: भा. IX. १८. ३३; २३. २०-1;

--(also Yadu kula and Yadu वम्श); members and descendants innumerable; one hundred and one families recognised.
1: भा. X. ९०. ४०-4.
Their king was Ugrasena. Ill-treated by Kamsa, they migrated to different countries like Kuru and पाञ्चाल, and became delighted at Kamsa's death. Their Purohita was

. ३६.
destroyed by कृष्ण before he left the earth, under the pretext of the Brahmanas' curse; the rest lost their reason after कृष्ण's departure to Heaven, drank wine and killed one another. Four or five alone left alive. Attained योग through the grace of Datta; became defunct after the महाभारत war.
6: Ib.

--a Janapada of मणिधान्य;
1: वा. ९९. ३८४.
the kingdom of.
2: Br. III. ७४. १९६.
--a name of कृष्ण. वा. ९६. ४०; Br. III. ७१. ४१.

--of the family of the यादव tribe; यादवस् from Yadu, son of ययाति;
1:

. १७.
begged excuse from वासुदेव for suspecting him from killing Prasena;
2: Ib. ३४. ३०; ४५. १८.
१०१ families are distinguished of whom विष्णु is the Lord; origi- nally Asuras killed in the देवासुर war, became incarnate as यादवस्.
3: Ib. ४७. 6; २५. 9.
--(Yadukula समाजम्); the popular assembly of the यादवस् to whom कृष्ण explained his adventure and recovery of the jewel Syamantaka. Vi. IV. १३. ६१-2, १३७, १४६.
--the wife of बाहु and mother of Sagara (s.v.) Br. III. ६३. १३०; वा. ८८. १३१.
--one of the names in the fourth Marut गण. वा. ६७. १२७.
